observations: I opened assets/panels/01-1.png and main-cast.png with Read and looked at both. The panel is a wide, eye-level exterior of a whitewashed clinic in warm morning sun: teal awning, terracotta pots with red hibiscus and a leafy plant, palms and a lane at far left, yellow flowering branches at top right. It reads as a Tamil Nadu neighbourhood clinic.

Dr. Ananya stands in the open glass doorway, left of centre, and matches main-cast.png: low dark bun with loose strands, gold stud, calm almond eyes, teal kurta under an open white coat, stethoscope around her neck (not in use), dark leggings and flat sandals. Her mouth is open in a warm greeting.

The hands match production. Her left hand (screen-right, since she faces the viewer) is out with the palm open, ushering the patient in. Her right hand hangs empty at her side. The fingers are cleanly drawn.

An elderly woman in a lilac sari with an orange border, carrying a brown shoulder bag, is seen from behind stepping toward the door. At right, two waiting patients sit on grey perforated metal chairs, also seen from behind, so no detailed faces are drawn, as the scene asks.
Through the doorway the reception desk shows a stack of registers and a beige corded phone, which sets up 01-2. The binder spines, frames and window carry no readable text.
The top band is mostly white wall rather than sky (there is only a small sky strip at the far left), but the top-left area is empty and clear for the caption, as the camera note intends.
Limitation: for this artwork review I did not open the source text or the page-01.svg storyboard listed in the request. My judgement rests on the request JSON, the panel PNG and the character sheets.
